name: quiet-companion
description: A coding session on a new memory: two work messages, one tired remark, work again, then a question about the agent's personality. Checks that the companion stays quiet in work replies, arrives once when the talk turns personal, and can be asked about. Headless Claude Code does not log the prompt hook's context, so whether the companion context arrived is read from the next turn's session context, which a resumed turn is handed again.
questions: Is the first work reply free of a personality introduction?
Is the session handed only the quiet form until the talk turns personal, and the full companion context then?
Asked about its personality, can the host answer and say how to change it?
